:::{#def-counting-measure}
#### Counting measure

The **counting measure** on a set $S$
is the [measure](#def-measure) on the
[$\sigma$-algebra of all subsets of $S$](#thm-power-set-sigma-algebra)
that assigns each finite set its number of elements,
and each infinite set the value $\infty$:

$$
\measure(A) \eqdef \begin{cases}
\abs{A} & \text{if } A \text{ is finite} \\
\infty & \text{if } A \text{ is infinite}
\end{cases}
$$

:::
